lines: Shikanosuke, who bravely jumped out despite being afraid, let his shuriken fly.
『Ridiculous!! Shuriken are useless against my immortal spirit body!!』
Heh-hehe! Sorry, but this isn't your average shuriken!
The shuriken reacted to the static electricity Shikanosuke had released, and they exploded right in front of the butler's eyes.
These were explosive shuriken, custom-made for Shikanosuke by the Gosha maintenance department.
As the ghost butler was losing his form due to the explosion, Hebiko assaulted him with an Octo-Jump.
With the strength of her tough octopus legs and her four ninjato, she cut up the butler's spiritual body and dispersed it.
『ーOhohohohoh!! Are you done with your attacks, octopus girl?』
The butler's body, which had been dispersed, reformed like nothing had ever happened.
『Then, I guess it is my turn now.』
Uwaahh!? No way!? Hebiko's in big trouble?
These poltergeists controlled by "Netherworld Jutsu" twisted around the furniture and decorations and threw them violently at Hebiko.
H-Hebiko's okay... but, this might be a bit rough...!
Hebiko parried the attacks from the poltergeists with her Ninjato, but there were so many of them that she could only focus on defending herself.
(Well... I guess it can't be helped.)
And as I watched them struggle I was sneaking on the edges toward the end of the hall, approaching Yukikaze's room.
I had expected it to be a hard fight for the two of them.
More so than that, we knew from the start that we had no chance of winning against that immortal ghost butler at all.
But if they could catch the attention of that ghost old man as a diversion then...
『Insolent boy!! Did you think that you really think you could deceive me!?』
Smoke arose from the floor right in front of me, and the butler of the Netherworld appeared from within.
...You've got some good eyes, old man. So you realized it was a distraction from the start?
『Didn't I say that I knew you were crafty, Fuma!? You fool!』
The butler of the Netherworld laughed loudly and made the surrounding objects fly around.
Hmm? Then do you know what this means?ーーー "Three."
I turned to the ghost old man floating before me, and raised three of my fingers.
『Ohohohohー!! I know, boy. This is the time remaining before your death!!』
The furniture and decorations flying around began to spin above my head violently.
The ghost old man began to count down in high spirits.
As he had said, if he made the flying furniture fall on me it would surely only take an instant for me to kick the bucket.
Mwahaha... I'm so sorry old man, but that's incorrect!!!
While I was avoiding the furniture I sent a signal to my partner who was observing us.
Yeah, that's right! "Three" is the number of shuriken that Shikanosuke threw!!
He already made one of these three explode. But the two others are still stuck in your body... Shikanosuke!!
G-Got it, Fuma!! Here we gooooo!!
Shikanosuke used static electricity to make the two remaining shuriken stuck in his back explodeー
The butler of the Netherworld had been completely obliterated and blown away.
Now!! Get to the room you two!
We opened the door, rushed inside, and saw a young girl in a uniform with a large headset on in front of monitors.
Uwaaaahh!? Wh-What are you all doing here!!?
Yukikaze took the headset off and looked back at us.
Naturally, she looked completely shocked due to our sudden entrance.
Heberybody finally found youuuuu! It was absolutely horrible, that monster butler kept chasing us!!
Eh!? Ehhh!? Butler... you mean Uncle!?
Shikanosuke and Hebiko had both clamped onto Yukikaze, ready to burst into tears.
On the other hand, Yukikaze looked like she was still unable to process what was happening.
Yeah! What's the deal with that butler exactlyー
It was the butler of the Netherworld.
He was supposed to have been completely blown away by the two shuriken explosions by Shikanosuke, but he had already reappeared like it was nothing.
What? Uncle, did you jump to conclusions and chase guests around again?
The butler of the Netherworld looked puzzled by the words of his master, Yukikaze.
Well, he did seem used to chasing people...
Oh, I'm really sorry everyone. Uncle always seems so desperate to protect me, sometimes he even kills people who visit.
...Are we just going to ignore that bit at the end there?
Hey, isn't that why nobody knows about Yukikaze's home?
It's a good thing heberybody survived here...
『Hmmm～, I am so ashamed of my misunderstanding!!』
After being told so by Yukikaze, he finally seemed to calm down from his enrage mode.
『Then, friends!! I have no choice but to apologize by cutting my stomach open...』
Wait, you're immortal so what's the point of that!!?
『Ohhh!? That is true isn't it, ohohohohー!』
It was a very practiced undead joke.
(I'm sure that old man isn't the least bit sorry...)
We nodded to each other with a fatigued look on our faces.
By the way, why are you three even here? Something to do with me?
Ah!? That's the adventure... I mean, the notebook.
Yes. The notebook Hebiko borrowed before the exams. Hebiko thought that Yukikaze-chan would be in trouble if you didn't have it to study with today.
Ohh, this one!! You could've just given it back tomorrow, you know? But thank you anyway, Hebiko♪
Yukikaze's notebook was safely returned by Hebiko.
We discovered the secret about Yukikaze's house and Hebiko returned the notes she had borrowed.
And with that today's adventure was over.
As I breathed a sigh of relief I finally realized that something was off.
It had a completely different feeling compared to all the other old fashioned rooms in the castle.
It had several large monitors, a very high-end PC case, and a gamepad on the deskー
Hey, Yukikaze. Your room is seriously great.
Looking around, Shikanosuke voiced what I was thinking.
Yeah. This room is clearly that of a gamer.
You got a problem with that? Even Taimanin play games you know.
Well, I guess they do, but how do I put this... this is like the real deal... hmm?
Wait. Your room, I've seen it somewhere before.
? What do you mean? Fuma-chan, it's the first time you've come to Yukikaze-chan's house, right?
H-Hey, Fuma! If you're finished here, just go home already!
As I was pondering, Yukikaze suddenly panicked and tried to make me leave her room.
No, w-wait a moment. I feel like it's on the tip of my tongueー
This is the same room as Y-kazeX-chan!!
That chair too, it's the same chair as the famous streamer Y-kazeX-chan!!!
A silent scream escaped from Yukikaze's throat.
You don't know her, Shikanosuke!!? You're really out of touch man～, she's a streamer Sakura and I are fans of!
She descended upon the FPS world like a shooting star! She has a 98% headshot percentage!!
Her legendary 30 kills video has over 1.24 million views!!!
Ehh. I don't really get it, but she sounds like someone really good at games.
She is! After cheating rumors she started streaming with her face while wearing a mask.
Which is also great. She has twintails, is flat-chested, sun-tanned, plus the mask makes her a very hot topic...
The flat-chested, sun-tanned girl with twintails turned away as fast as she could.
(I-I see...!! So this is how it was!!!)
I had the wrong idea about all of this.
The secret about Yukikaze's house wasn't that it was a castle nor her ghost butler...
It's youuuuuuuuuuuuu!!? Yukikaze, y-you're THAT Y-kazeX-chan!!?
Wh-Wh-Wh-Wh-What are you saying, stupid Fuma! I-I'm not! I know nothing about thaaaaaat!!
There's no way it's not you!!! This room, that chair, and that small chest!! It can't be anyone but you!!
Th-That's just some kind of coincidence! More importantly, just leave or I'll kill you, stupid Fuma!
『Kill? So this boy was an enemy after all, Miss Yukikaze!? May I kill him and bury him in the backyard!!?』
Aaaaahhh!!?? N-No, Fuma is a friend!!! More importantly, killing is forbidden, Uncle!!
『What, he is your friend!? Then we need to welcome your friends with the specialty of this house: stir-fried vegetables!』
Ah! I want to eat stir-fried vegetables!
I got it, damn it!! Then show me your gamer ID!!! With that, I can easily check if it'sー
Just leaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaave!!! Everyone, get out of my roooooooooooooooom!!
The voice of Y-kazeX-chan echoed through the tranquil mountains.
It was another peaceful night at the Mizuki castle.
